query: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_ticks FROM collection_manual_ticks; SELECT COUNT(*) as orphaned_ticks FROM collection_manual_ticks cmt LEFT JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = cmt.receivable_id WHERE ar.id IS NULL; SELECT COUNT(*) as linked_ticks FROM collection_manual_ticks cmt INNER JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = cmt.receivable_id;
